2014_spells.stone-shape.description: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape that suits your purpose. So, for example, you could shape a large rock into a weapon, idol, or coffer, or make a small passage through a wall, as long as the wall is less than 5 feet thick. You could also shape a stone door or its frame to seal the door shut. The object you create can have up to two hinges and a latch, but finer mechanical detail isn't possible.
2014_spells.stone-shape.effectSummary: Create a magical area that affects creatures inside it
2014_spells.stone-shape.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape that suits your purpose. So, for example, you could shape a large rock into a weapon, idol, or coffer, or make a small passage through a wall, as long as the wall is less than 5 feet thick; The object you create can have up to two hinges and a latch, but finer mechanical detail isn't possible. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
